name: QuickSTRM
description: Eliminates remote ffprobe latency when playing .strm files for near-instant playback start. Specifically engineered for low-power host servers (Intel Core i3 with QuickSync) by enforcing a strict 2-process concurrency gate, 500-item bounded persistence queue, 1-hour dead-link negative cache, and in-memory codec mapping tailored for direct play on Astra clients streaming Radarr H.264/AAC/AC3 media.
overview: Instant-start STRM acceleration plugin engineered to prevent CPU starvation on Core i3 QuickSync hardware and optimize parsing of H.264/AAC/AC3 direct-play streams sourced via Radarr for the Astra client.

versions.changelog:
Initial Standalone Release (QuickSTRM v1.0.0.0)

Core Architecture Rewrite:
- Standalone Fork & Unique Identity: Forked under namespace QuickSTRM with new GUID (1278dbd6-8399-46c0-8e64-31f2d9e022ae).
- IMediaSourceManager Decorator: Clean DI decorator wrapping Jellyfin's native media source manager.
- Dual-Path Probing: 5-second in-memory inline probe for instant first-play with direct mapping of codec profiles, levels, container formats, and bitrates; decoupled asynchronous background persistence saves stream metadata to database for subsequent zero-probe instant start.
- Graceful Fallback: Immediate fallback to raw .strm URL on timeout or queue starvation ensures client devices (e.g., Fire TV Stick 4K Astra client) resolve streams natively.

Hardware & Resource Optimizations (Core i3 QuickSync):
- Strict 2-Process Concurrency Gate: Hard SemaphoreSlim limit prevents CPU thread starvation and preserves QuickSync hardware transcoding capacity.
- 500-Item Bounded Persistence Queue: Eliminates unbounded RAM allocation under heavy multi-client requests.
- Atomic Queue Deduplication: Atomic ConcurrentDictionary drops rapid duplicate playback probe requests.
- Zombie Process Elimination: Direct token cancellation kills underlying ffprobe OS processes.

Resilience & Dead Link Protection:
- 1-Hour Absolute Negative Failure Cache: IMemoryCache fast-rejects known dead or rate-limited links without thread pool starvation.
- Anti-Lockout Design: Absolute expiration prevents automated client retries from causing perpetual lockouts.

UI & REST API:
- Dashboard: Real-time Background Queue metrics (waiting/running) and Reset Failure Cache button.
- RESTful Endpoints: Complete /QuickStrm/* administrative API for queue metrics, cache resets, and probe control.

CI/CD & Repository Distribution:
- Automated GitHub Actions pipeline targeting .NET 9.0 and custom Jellyfin repository manifest.json support.
